mapper.sql: r.rating_id, r.user_id, r.novel_id, r.score, r.review_content, r.status, r.review_audit_status, r.created_at, u.nickname, u.avatar_url, n.title AS novel_title
mapper.select: SELECT FROM novel_rating r JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = r.user_id JOIN novel n ON n.novel_id = r.novel_id WHERE r.novel_id = #{novelId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.review_audit_status = 1 ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC, r.rating_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM novel_rating r WHERE r.novel_id = #{novelId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.review_audit_status = 1

SELECT FROM novel_rating r JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = r.user_id JOIN novel n ON n.novel_id = r.novel_id WHERE r.review_content IS NOT NULL AND r.review_audit_status = #{reviewAuditStatus} ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC, r.rating_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM novel_rating r WHERE r.review_content IS NOT NULL AND r.review_audit_status = #{reviewAuditStatus}
